patch_description: Introduce per-upload deltas for the RY layer to boost expressivity without a dramatic depth increase. Replace the single shared ry_corner/ry_edge/ry_center parameters with a base plus per-upload deltas (ry_*_base and ry_*_delta_upload{0,1,2}). Update the ansatz construction accordingly and modify the ansatz application to compute angles as base + delta(upload_index) for each gate, using a two-pass approach to safely combine base and deltas. This should increase parameter efficiency and potentially improve validation/test performance.
